snippet.title: After Long Night — Official Launch Trailer | RTS + Base-Building Survival Game
snippet.description:
#RTS #gaming #indiegame #steamgame #basebuilding #survivalgame 

The apocalypse is here… Are you ready to survive the long night?

After Long Night is an indie RTS + base-building survival game where you:
🧟 Face endless zombie hordes
🏚️ Build and upgrade your base
⚔️ Train survivors and command your forces

Steam release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351650/_/

Follow us for updates and more content:
Discord: https://discord.gg/R7MMSBHFec

Survive. Adapt. Rebuild. Your long night starts now.
